issues.description: v3-beta default speaker disagrees with itself: config says 'shubh', docs/PR/enum order say 'aditya'
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS['bulbul:v3-beta'].default_speaker is 'shubh', but the module docstring, class docstring, README, and PR description all declare 'aditya' as the default. Pick one source of truth and reconcile; this is a silent regression for anyone relying on documented defaults.

issues.description: Pace bounds are declared in two layers that disagree, then silently clamped instead of rejected
issues.detail: InputParams declares pace ge=0.3, le=3.0 at the Pydantic layer, then __init__ silently clamps to the per-model pace_range with only a warning. The precondition is unstated: callers cannot tell whether out-of-range pace is rejected or clamped. Either reject with ValueError or narrow Field bounds per model; do not do both half-heartedly.

issues.description: Incompatible-parameter warnings use value-equality against defaults instead of detecting user intent
issues.detail: Checks like `params.pitch != 0.0` conflate 'user passed default' with 'user passed nothing'. A v3 user explicitly setting pitch=0.0 gets no warning; the invariant 'warn iff user supplied an unsupported parameter' holds only by coincidence. Use Pydantic's model_fields_set or an explicit sentinel.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models
issues.detail: The function returns v2 speakers for any unrecognized model name with no diagnostic, masking typos and future-model errors as plausible-but-wrong answers. A caller validating a speaker against a misspelled model gets accepted input. Raise on unknown model, or return Optional[List[str]]; do not invent a default.

issues.description: STT _connect drops input_audio_codec from connect_kwargs with no justification
issues.detail: The pre-PR connect payload included 'input_audio_codec': self._input_audio_codec; the refactored payload removes it. If the SDK or v2.5 endpoints required this key, this is a silent behavior change for existing saarika:v2.5 / saaras:v2.5 deployments presented as a refactor. Document whether the codec is now implicit or restore the field.

issues.description: voice_id is never validated against the model's allowed speaker set despite the data being available
issues.detail: TTSModelConfig.speakers and the SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums exist precisely to constrain valid voices per model, but __init__ accepts voice_id: Optional[str] without checking membership. A mismatched voice fails at request time instead of construction time. Validate `voice_id in self._config.speakers` at init, or the data is decorative.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor to dataclass-driven ModelConfig / TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS is the right move — model capability becomes data instead of substring matches on model names. But the discipline is incomplete: a v3-beta default-speaker contradiction between code and docs, pace bounds split across Pydantic Field and silent per-model clamping, value-equality used as a proxy for user intent, get_speakers_for_model silently returning v2 fallbacks, an undocumented removal of input_audio_codec from STT connect_kwargs, and unused speaker-set validation in __init__. Resolve the spec/code contradictions and decide whether out-of-range parameters are refused or clamped — pick one — before merging.
